lines.text: 是这样的：每隔一阵子——不常，但偶尔——你能亲身参与正义得以伸张的那一刻。那一刻真的相当令人激动。
lines.en: It's that every now and again - not often, but occasionally - you get to be a part of justice being done. That really is quite a thrill when that happens.
lines.note: （核证证据：IMDb Quotes（逐字，qt3315389）https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0107818/quotes/?item=qt3315389 （"Andrew Beckett: It's that every now and again - not often, but occasionally - you get to be a part of justice being done. That really is quite a thrill when ..."）；MovieQuotesDB https://www.moviequotedb.com/movies/philadelphia/quote_55183.html 同句逐字；Scraps from the Loft 全片转写 https://scrapsfromtheloft.com/movies/philadelphia-1993-transcript/ 同句（末句作 "It really is quite a thrill"））

lines.text: 米勒先生，在这个法庭内，正义是无视种族、信仰、肤色、宗教和性取向的。／恕我直言，法官大人，可我们并不是生活在这个法庭之内，是吗？
lines.en: In this courtroom, Mr. Miller, justice is blind to matters of race, creed, color, religion, and sexual orientation. / With all due respect, your honor, we don't live in this courtroom, do we?
lines.character: 加内特法官 / 乔·米勒
lines.note: （核证证据：IMDb Quotes https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0107818/quotes/ 与 Quotes.net https://www.quotes.net/mquote/72960 均逐字收录该庭上对话；中文通行译法见豆瓣笔记《〈费城故事〉+〈毕业生〉经典台词笔记》（m.douban.com，2012："在法庭内，正义无视于种族、教义、肤色、宗教和性取向"／"但是，我们并不是生活在法庭之内，是吗？"））
